---
title: Make a system
description: Define models, contracts, a frontend, and its system authentication and aggregate authorization with Zerospin make methods.
---

This guide shows the direct shape for defining a small system. It keeps each exported piece visible so the relationships between models, contracts, frontend, aggregate owner, and system are easy to inspect.

## Imports

Import the builders, primitive descriptors, typed error shape, and Effect schema tools used by the system.

```ts
import * as sdk from '@zerospin/sdk';
import { makeModelIdSchema } from '@zerospin/core/models/makeIdSchema.js';
import { Effect, Schema } from 'effect';
```

## Models

Models define the resource types in the system. Each model identity has explicitly authored versions. These models each declare their first version. The `User` model supplies this aggregate's user identity. `List` belongs to a user, and `Item` belongs to a list.

```ts
export const User = sdk.makeModelVersion(
  sdk.makeModel({ name: 'user', abbreviation: 'usr' }),
  {
    attributes: {
      name: sdk.primitives.text(),
    },
    indexes: [],
    version: '1.0.0',
  },
);

export const List = sdk.makeModelVersion(
  sdk.makeModel({ name: 'list', abbreviation: 'lst' }),
  {
    attributes: {
      name: sdk.primitives.text(),
      userId: sdk.primitives.ref({
        table: User.table,
        relation: 'user',
        inverse: 'lists',
      }),
    },
    indexes: [],
    version: '1.0.0',
  },
);

export const Item = sdk.makeModelVersion(
  sdk.makeModel({ name: 'item', abbreviation: 'tsk' }),
  {
    attributes: {
      listId: sdk.primitives.ref({
        table: List.table,
        relation: 'list',
        inverse: 'items',
      }),
      name: sdk.primitives.text(),
    },
    indexes: [],
    version: '1.0.0',
  },
);
```

## Contracts

Contracts define commands. Each contract has a payload shape, declared model versions, and a program. The program receives mutation constructors bound to those exact model versions.

`createList` creates a `List` resource and stores the user relationship on `userId`.

```ts
export const createList = sdk.makeContractVersion(
  sdk.defineCommand('createList'),
  {
    payload: {
      id: sdk.primitives.foreignKey({ abbreviation: List.abbreviation }),
      name: sdk.primitives.text(),
      userId: sdk.primitives.foreignKey({ abbreviation: User.abbreviation }),
    },
    models: { list: List },
    program: props => {
      const { payload, models } = props;
      const { id, name, userId } = payload;
      return Effect.all({
        created: models.list.create({
          resourceId: id,
          attributes: {
            name,
            userId,
          },
        }),
      });
    },
    version: '1.0.0',
  },
);
```

`createItem` creates an `Item` resource and stores the list relationship on `listId`.

```ts
export const createItem = sdk.makeContractVersion(
  sdk.defineCommand('createItem'),
  {
    payload: {
      id: sdk.primitives.foreignKey({ abbreviation: Item.abbreviation }),
      listId: sdk.primitives.foreignKey({ abbreviation: List.abbreviation }),
      name: sdk.primitives.text(),
    },
    models: { item: Item },
    program: props => {
      const { payload, models } = props;
      const { id, listId, name } = payload;
      return Effect.all({
        created: models.item.create({
          resourceId: id,
          attributes: {
            listId,
            name,
          },
        }),
      });
    },
    version: '1.0.0',
  },
);
```

`updateList` changes the list name with the `List` model's matching versioned update schema and constructor.

```ts
export const updateList = sdk.makeContractVersion(
  sdk.defineCommand('updateList'),
  {
    payload: {
      id: sdk.primitives.foreignKey({ abbreviation: List.abbreviation }),
      name: sdk.primitives.text(),
    },
    models: { list: List },
    program: props => {
      const { payload, models } = props;
      const { id, name } = payload;
      return Effect.all({
        updated: models.list.update({
          resourceId: id,
          attributes: { name },
        }),
      });
    },
    version: '1.0.0',
  },
);
```

## Frontend

The frontend selects models and contracts from one aggregate version. Its lock must match those definitions exactly and include every selected contract's declared mutation models. Frontends are not registered on the server aggregate.

```ts
export const listFrontend = sdk.makeFrontendController({
  systemName: 'system1',
  aggregateName: 'user',
  name: 'main',
  aggregateVersion: '1.0.0',
  contracts: {
    createList: { contract: createList },
    createItem: { contract: createItem },
    updateList: { contract: updateList },
  },
  models: {
    list: List,
    item: Item,
    user: User,
  },
});
```

## System authentication and aggregate authorization

Authentication produces a user ID. The selected aggregate authorizes that user against its database. Selections define visible resources for snapshots and live updates; the frontend lock further narrows the delivered models and accepted commands.

```ts
export const user = sdk.makeAggregateVersion(
  sdk.makeAggregate({ name: 'user' }),
  {
    version: '1.0.0',
    authorize: ({ userId, db }) =>
      Effect.gen(function* () {
        const row = yield* Effect.sync(() =>
          db.query.user
            .findFirst({
              where: { id: { eq: userId } },
            })
            .sync(),
        );
        if (row === undefined) {
          return yield* new sdk.ZerospinError({
            code: 'user-not-found',
            message: `User ${userId} was not found`,
          });
        }
      }),
    models: { user: User, list: List, item: Item },
    contracts: {
      createList: { contract: createList },
      createItem: { contract: createItem },
      updateList: { contract: updateList },
    },
    selections: {
      user: sdk.makeSelection({
        model: User,
        where: ({ userId }) => ({ id: userId }),
      }),
      list: sdk.makeSelection({
        model: List,
        where: ({ userId }) => ({ user: { id: userId } }),
      }),
      item: sdk.makeSelection({
        model: Item,
        where: ({ userId }) => ({ list: { user: { id: userId } } }),
      }),
    },
  },
);

export const system = sdk.makeSystem({
  name: 'system1',
  authentication: [
    sdk.makeAuthenticationVersion({
      version: '1.0.0',
      signature: Schema.Struct({ userId: makeModelIdSchema(User) }),
      authenticate: ({ signature }) => Effect.succeed(signature.userId),
    }),
  ],
  aggregates: { user: [user] },
});
```

This example accepts a user ID as its demonstration signature. Applications supply their own authenticator. Server execution uses the aggregate's contracts and guards directly; it does not load a frontend controller or run frontend binding adapters.

Frontends sharing the same system, aggregate, aggregate version, and authenticated user share a `UserVersionedAggregateRepo` and `UserVersionedAggregateChain`. Changing a frontend lock creates a new capability and snapshot, not a new server replica.
